title: Data Engineer

nodes.title: Python & Advanced Data Structures for Pipelines
nodes.subtitle: Memory management, generators, collections (deque, defaultdict), multiprocessing, typing
learning_objectives: Stream multi-gigabyte datasets without memory crashes using Python generators
Leverage multiprocessing to parallelize CPU-intensive data transformations
feynman_prompts: Why do Python generators consume constant memory regardless of stream size?
key_misconceptions: Loading entire multi-gigabyte CSV files into memory with a single read() call

nodes.title: Advanced SQL & Analytical Data Warehousing
nodes.subtitle: Window functions, partitioning, star schemas, dimensional modeling, surrogate keys
learning_objectives: Design star schema warehouse models with fact and dimension tables
Author high-throughput window queries for customer lifecycle tracking
feynman_prompts: Why are surrogate integer keys preferred over natural keys in data warehouses?
key_misconceptions: Querying production transactional databases directly for heavy analytical batch reports

nodes.title: Distributed Systems Theory for Data Engineers
nodes.subtitle: CAP theorem, horizontal partitioning, data skew, network shuffle, master-worker architecture
learning_objectives: Analyze how distributed file systems (HDFS, S3) store and replicate data blocks
Identify and diagnose data skew where a single worker process takes 10x longer
feynman_prompts: What is network shuffle in distributed computing and why is it the most expensive bottleneck?
key_misconceptions: Assuming distributed processing is always faster than single-node processing for small datasets (< 10GB)

nodes.title: Apache Spark Core Architecture & RDDs
nodes.subtitle: Driver, executors, cluster manager, DAG execution engine, narrow vs wide transformations
learning_objectives: Explain how Apache Spark's catalyst optimizer compiles transformations into execution DAGs
Differentiate narrow transformations (map, filter) from wide transformations (groupBy, join)
feynman_prompts: Why do wide transformations require network shuffle while narrow transformations do not?
key_misconceptions: Calling count() or collect() repeatedly in Spark loops, triggering repeated DAG re-executions

nodes.title: PySpark DataFrames & Spark SQL
nodes.subtitle: DataFrames, schemas, column expressions, UDFs, caching, explain plan analysis
learning_objectives: Execute large-scale distributed data transformations using PySpark DataFrames
Avoid Python serialization bottlenecks by using native PySpark functions instead of custom UDFs
feynman_prompts: Why are Python UDFs in PySpark significantly slower than native Spark SQL expressions?
key_misconceptions: Using collect() on a billion-row DataFrame, crashing the Spark driver node with an OOM

nodes.title: Spark Performance Optimization & Shuffling
nodes.subtitle: Data skew, salt keys, broadcast joins, partition sizing, dynamic allocation
learning_objectives: Eliminate out-of-memory errors caused by data skew using salt keys
Accelerate lookup joins by broadcasting small dimension tables to all executors
feynman_prompts: How does a broadcast hash join eliminate expensive network shuffling?
key_misconceptions: Broadcasting a massive multi-gigabyte table, causing executor out-of-memory crashes

nodes.title: Storage Formats & Data Lakes: Parquet & ORC
nodes.subtitle: Columnar storage, row groups, dictionary encoding, snappy compression, metadata statistics
learning_objectives: Store petabyte-scale data efficiently using columnar Apache Parquet format
Leverage parquet column metadata statistics to achieve high-speed partition pruning
feynman_prompts: How does columnar storage allow queries selecting 2 out of 100 columns to read 98% less data?
key_misconceptions: Storing multi-terabyte analytical data lakes as uncompressed raw CSV or JSON files

nodes.title: Lakehouse Architecture: Delta Lake & Apache Iceberg
nodes.subtitle: ACID transactions on object storage, time travel, schema evolution, compaction (vacuum)
learning_objectives: Implement ACID transactions on cloud object storage using Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg
Execute historical audit queries using lakehouse time travel and restore features
feynman_prompts: How does the transaction log (Delta Log / Iceberg metadata) enable ACID guarantees on S3?
key_misconceptions: Allowing millions of tiny files to accumulate in the lakehouse without compaction (the small file problem)

nodes.title: Workflow Orchestration with Apache Airflow
nodes.subtitle: DAGs, operators, sensors, task dependencies, retries, XComs, connection management
learning_objectives: Author robust data pipeline DAGs in Apache Airflow with automated retries and alerting
Design idempotent pipeline tasks that can be safely re-run without duplicating data
feynman_prompts: Why must every task in an Airflow pipeline be strictly idempotent?
key_misconceptions: Passing massive multi-gigabyte datasets through Airflow XComs instead of object storage pointers

nodes.title: Cloud Data Warehouses: Snowflake & BigQuery
nodes.subtitle: Virtual warehouses, clustering keys, micro-partitions, external stages, zero-copy cloning
learning_objectives: Configure compute right-sizing and auto-suspend in Snowflake to optimize costs
Load data from cloud object storage stages using high-performance COPY commands
feynman_prompts: How does the separation of storage and compute in Snowflake enable independent scaling?
key_misconceptions: Leaving large virtual warehouses running 24/7 with zero active queries

nodes.title: Modern Data Transformations with dbt
nodes.subtitle: dbt models, ref(), sources, tests, documentation, incremental models, lineage graphs
learning_objectives: Build modular, version-controlled analytical models using dbt (Data Build Tool)
Implement incremental models that process only new or modified raw data
feynman_prompts: How does dbt transform data in-warehouse (ELT) instead of legacy out-of-warehouse ETL?
key_misconceptions: Hardcoding raw database and table names instead of using the dbt {{ source() }} and {{ ref() }} macros

nodes.title: Data Quality Testing & Great Expectations
nodes.subtitle: Schema validation, null checks, uniqueness, anomaly tests, automated pipeline alerting
learning_objectives: Enforce automated data quality contracts using Great Expectations or dbt tests
Halt downstream pipeline execution automatically when critical data quality checks fail
feynman_prompts: Why should data quality checks run automatically before transforming data into production marts?
key_misconceptions: Discovering data corruption only after executive dashboards display broken numbers

nodes.title: Streaming Fundamentals & Apache Kafka
nodes.subtitle: Topics, partitions, producers, consumers, offsets, consumer lag, message retention
learning_objectives: Publish and consume high-throughput event streams with Apache Kafka
Monitor and mitigate consumer lag to prevent real-time pipeline delays
feynman_prompts: Explain how Kafka partitions provide horizontal write scalability and ordered processing.
key_misconceptions: Setting up Kafka topics with only 1 partition, creating an inescapable throughput bottleneck

nodes.title: Stream Processing: Spark Structured Streaming & Flink
nodes.subtitle: Micro-batching vs continuous processing, watermarks, event time vs processing time, windowing
learning_objectives: Process live streaming events using Spark Structured Streaming or Apache Flink
Handle out-of-order and late-arriving events accurately using watermarking
feynman_prompts: What is the fundamental difference between Event Time and Processing Time in stream analytics?
key_misconceptions: Assuming streaming systems never receive late data, leading to incorrect aggregation metrics

nodes.title: Change Data Capture (CDC) & Debezium
nodes.subtitle: Database transaction logs (WAL/binlog), Debezium, streaming database mutations to Kafka
learning_objectives: Stream real-time database row mutations directly to Kafka using Debezium CDC
Achieve zero-impact data ingestion without querying source production databases
feynman_prompts: Why is log-based Change Data Capture (CDC) vastly superior to periodic query polling?
key_misconceptions: Polling transactional databases with SELECT queries every 5 seconds, causing CPU spikes

nodes.title: Data Governance, Cataloging & Data Lineage
nodes.subtitle: Data catalogs (DataHub, OpenMetadata), metadata ingestion, column-level lineage, GDPR compliance
learning_objectives: Trace end-to-end column-level data lineage from source API to final executive dashboard
Automate metadata cataloging so data scientists can discover trusted enterprise datasets
feynman_prompts: Why is automated data lineage essential for complying with GDPR 'Right to be Forgotten' requests?
key_misconceptions: Documenting data dictionaries in static Excel files that become outdated within a week

nodes.title: DataOps: CI/CD & Infrastructure as Code for Data
nodes.subtitle: Terraform for data infrastructure, automated dbt testing in PRs, isolated dev environments
learning_objectives: Automate dbt model testing and schema validation on Git pull requests
Provision reproducible cloud data warehouses and storage buckets with Terraform
feynman_prompts: How does DataOps apply DevOps software engineering best practices to data pipelines?
key_misconceptions: Testing data transformation logic directly in the production data warehouse

nodes.title: Data Pipeline Monitoring & Warehouse FinOps
nodes.subtitle: Pipeline SLA alerts, compute cost attribution, query cost profiling, data downtime reduction
learning_objectives: Profile and eliminate runaway analytical queries that trigger massive cloud warehouse bills
Establish pipeline SLA monitors alerting on stalled jobs before business stakeholders notice
feynman_prompts: Why is monitoring data warehouse query consumption essential for cloud FinOps cost governance?
key_misconceptions: Ignoring queries that trigger petabyte-scale un-partitioned table scans every 10 minutes

description: Master Data Engineer with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
